paragraphs: Quantcast’s real‑time ad optimisation demands models that adapt instantly; I’ve engineered AI agents that resolve complex biological queries in real time, mirroring that need for rapid, accurate decision‑making.

I built a tool‑calling LLM agent using LangChain, AWS Bedrock and Claude Haiku 4.5 for a multi‑omics cancer research platform, integrating three specialised tools for gene alias resolution, scoring‑methodology explanation and dataset provenance.
I developed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker, ensuring scalable, production‑ready inference.
